name: JAZF zinc finger 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: JAZF1 encodes juxtaposed with another zinc finger protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

function.text: JAZF1 encodes juxtaposed with another zinc finger protein 1. Based in part on similarity, it functions as a transcriptional corepressor of orphan nuclear receptor NR2C2. It inhibits expression of the gluconeogenesis enzyme PCK2 through inhibition of NR2C2 activity. It is also involved in transcriptional activation of NAMPT by promoting expression of PPARA and PPARD.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving JAZF1 have been reported in endometrial stromal sarcoma.
